rationale: Given the Chief Justice’s stated preference for a minimalist holding that inability to satisfy § 2255(h) does not itself trigger the saving clause, Roberts is the modal assignee/author, with Thomas/Barrett/Alito also plausible for a text-and-structure opinion. The most likely separate writings are a Sotomayor dissent (possibly joined by Jackson, with some chance of a separate Jackson dissent emphasizing the present-tense/Suspension Clause concern) and a modest concurrence from a textualist (Thomas or Gorsuch) to underscore limits on constitutional-avoidance reasoning.
